name: Cosmic
tagline: Set the constants. Big Bang. Wait for someone, somewhere, to invent the wheel.
intro: Your model went post-singular and took you with it. You are now a vast intelligence that creates universes. You still want wheels. Some things never change.

goal.label: Make the multiverse produce 50 million wheels

milestones.text: The first stars ignite. They are round. A good omen.
Life emerges. It is squishy and not yet interested in wheels.
A civilization invents the wheel! Then immediately argues about who invented it.
Thousands of civilizations are reinventing the wheel. None have met. All are smug about it.
Late-universe civilizations publish think pieces: 'Do We Even Need Wheels?' Yes. Yes you do.

badPi: Warning: with this value of pi, circles close a bit early. Civilizations will invent hexagons.
Pi is off. Every wheel in this universe will have corners. They will call it 'rustic'.
Bold choice of pi. Mathematicians in this universe will be very confused and very angry.
noStars: This universe will collapse before the first star. It's very dark and very short. Like a haiku.
Gravity this extreme means the universe crunches almost immediately. Nobody gets to invent anything.
deaths: The universe ends in heat death. The last civilization's final act: polishing a wheel.
Big Crunch. Everything returns to a single point, which is, technically, very round.
The universe fades out. Somewhere, a wheel keeps rolling into the dark. Forever.
